title: Register of Premium Billing Accounts Arrangements: Entry Conditions and Group Administration Terms
content:
Cascade Mutual Dental & Vision funds every insured plan through a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement. The register below lists the seven arrangements in their order of rank, the entry condition of each, and the terms that apply to group administration.

## Entry conditions

| Rank | Arrangement | Customer type | Market | Further entry condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | individual | individual | none |
| 2 | Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | individual | individual | payment method on file is EFT or card |
| 3 | Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | individual | individual | none |
| 4 | Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | individual | individual | none |
| 5 | Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | individual | individual exchange | none |
| 6 | Cascade Group List Bill | employer group | group | at least 2 enrolled lives |
| 7 | Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | employer group | group | at least 100 enrolled lives |

## Group administration terms

- **Retro termination limit** — calendar days; a group may terminate a member retroactively no more than this many days before the date the termination is reported, and premium is credited only for those months; 0 for individual arrangements.
- **Retro addition limit** — calendar days; a group may add a member retroactively no more than this many days before the date reported; 0 for individual arrangements.
- **Group remittance report** — whether the group submits its own monthly enrollment and premium report instead of paying a carrier-built invoice.
- **Reconciliation interval** — months between carrier reconciliations of a self-administered group's reports against enrollment; 0 when not applicable.

| Arrangement | Retro termination limit (days) | Retro addition limit (days) | Group remittance report | Reconciliation interval (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 60 | 60 | no | 0 |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 60 | 60 | yes | 3 |

**Hypothetical selections.** An employer group with 40 enrolled lives meets the entry condition of Cascade Group List Bill (at least 2) but not that of Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill (at least 100); a group with 100 enrolled lives meets both. An individual whose payment method on file is check does not meet the entry condition of Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly.
